answer: The jade schedule is applied in nebula and onyx reveals each instalment. An farming party as a result cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and hence 25% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2550 identities would post 1095 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
